feat: Implement comprehensive rate limiting for all API routes

Added Next.js middleware for intelligent rate limiting:

1. Rate Limiting Configuration
   - Auth endpoints (/api/auth): 5 requests/min
   - Registration (/api/v1/register): 3 requests/min
   - Upload endpoints (/api/v1/upload): 10 requests/min
   - General API (/api/v1): 30 requests/min

2. Implementation Details
   - IP-based rate limiting with support for proxies
   - Checks x-forwarded-for and x-real-ip headers
   - 60-second sliding window
   - 500 unique tokens per interval
   - Returns 429 status with Retry-After header

3. Security Benefits
   - Prevents brute force attacks on auth endpoints
   - Prevents registration spam
   - Protects against DoS attacks
   - Rate limits per client IP
